lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Old-Timer?
What is it?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You won't believe it.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I found a really interesting food recently.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'm super curious as to how it tastes.
Pretty much anything that's edible piques your curiosity.
Don't you ever talk about anything else other than food?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Guilty as charged!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: However, this food I found recently

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: has made me even more curious than usual.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Sure, there are plenty of other things we could talk about.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Like drinks, or desserts.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Wait, I guess those technically count as food too...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Oh well, hehe.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: aren't you wondering what it is?
I am. What is it?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Oh no no. It's no fun if I just tell you outright.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You've gotta guess.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: It's about 25cm long,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: and it's got 200 small bumps or so all around it.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: There's a bunch of bloodshot eyes on its backside.
Hold up a minute.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: What's the matter?
Are you sure this is a good one?
This sounds like some kind of bug.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Positive!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Amazing! I knew you'd get it eventually.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: It's an edible insect called the dragon centipede.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: It's become quite popular as of late.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Are you interested in trying it?
That's a big no from me on insects.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: How come?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You shouldn't be so picky.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Stay here, and I'll bring you one.
I've gotta get out of here before Belorta brings me something bizarre.
Sorry, but I've got to go to work now. See you later.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Aw, really? I've got it all ready for you...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: We'll just have to wait until next time.
